title: Spill read-back returns the projected full text
requirement: A tool result that was projected into a spill file can be read back whole by the agent through the same tools/post-execute listener: a read whose file_path lies in .dsh/spill is never projected again at any size, and read carries its own 64 KiB floor so an ordinary document arrives complete (REQ-172, REQ-128).
steps: run the real tools/post-execute listener of plugins/run-code-projection on the 27 380-byte run_code fixture with a temporary workspace; keep the banner and the path it names

run the same listener as a read whose file_path is that banner path, and again with the same file named relative to the workspace, and again for a 217 600-byte spill above the read floor: each result must come back identical, without a banner and without a second spill file
run the listener as a read of a 12 000-byte document in the workspace: under the read floor, it must arrive whole; a read above the floor must be projected and the banner must name the tool
keep the untouched cases: short, error, image, other tool, aborted, blocked, value-replaced, no workspace, unwritable spill, insufficient saving, legacy banner
proof/negative-control.mjs takes the module from git at a pre-fix revision, runs this same proof against it, and requires a non-zero exit with the read-back rows red
expected: The driver exits 0 with 22 checks PASS. CASE_NEGATIVE_CONTROL=pre-change exits 1 (23 checks, the control row red); against the pre-fix module (git revision a1eb322, 13 950 bytes) the same proof exits 1 with four red rows — read of the banner file, read by relative path, read of a 217 600-byte spill, and the ordinary 12 000-byte document — because that module projected a read at 8192 bytes and had no spill exception.
